qa_pairs.question: What potential issue might users encounter with Intel C/C++ compilers by default?
qa_pairs.answer: Intel C/C++ compilers may default to using possibly unsafe optimizations for floating-point operations.

qa_pairs.question: What specific options are recommended for users of Intel C/C++ compilers to ensure ANSI/ISO/IEEE standards-compliant floating-point support?
qa_pairs.answer: Users of Intel C/C++ compilers are recommended to use one of two options: `-fp-model precise` or `-fp-model source`, for ANSI/ISO/IEEE standards-compliant floating-point support.

qa_pairs.question: Where can users find additional details about controlling floating-point behaviour in Intel compilers and libraries?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can find more details by reading the Intel man pages (e.g., `man icpc`) and referring to the Intel slideshow titled "Floating-point control in the Intel compiler and libraries".
